slides.title: Hold the wheel
slides.text: Steerify keeps your Claude Code sessions next to a board: what to decide, what to look at, what to ship. Claude builds. You steer. Someone has to.

slides.title: Sessions in sync with the roadmap
slides.text: Every roadmap item has a Start button. The session opens in the right repo, already briefed, and the item shows its status as the work moves. No orphan terminals.

slides.title: Choices, with pictures
slides.text: When Claude needs a decision, it asks on the board, with a mockup for every option and one marked as suggested. Pick one, or write a note. That's the meeting.

slides.title: Visual review
slides.text: Finished work lands in To test as pictures. Press [⌘] and click to pin a note exactly where it's wrong. Refine goes back to the session that built it.

slides.title: Organised progress
slides.text: Every item moves from choose, to build, to test, to shipped. The progress bar fills itself. Nobody updates it by hand, least of all you.

slides.title: Say OK. It ships.
slides.text: What you approved waits in Release. One click, and the session commits its own changes, deploys, and marks it live.

slides.title: Never get lost
slides.text: Lost? Press [⌘J]. Steerify shows the one thing waiting on you, in any project. Read less. Ship more.
